<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organization" processRef="VacationRequest" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_EMPLOYEE" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SYSTEM" name="Vacation Request System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SUPERVISOR" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>receive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>decide</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>returnRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endHandled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Vacation requirement arises" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit" name="Submit the vacation request" />
    <bpmn:task id="register" name="Register the vacation requirement" />
    <bpmn:task id="receive" name="Receive the vacation request" />
    <bpmn:task id="decide" name="Approve or reject the request" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="approved" name="Request approved?" />
    <bpmn:task id="returnRequest" name="Return the application to the employee" />
    <bpmn:task id="review" name="Review the rejection reasons" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endRejected" name="Request rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="notify" name="Generate notification to the Human Resources Representative" />
    <bpmn:task id="complete" name="Complete the respective management procedures" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endHandled" name="Vacation request handled" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="submit" targetRef="register" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="register" targetRef="receive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="receive" targetRef="decide" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="decide" targetRef="approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="no" sourceRef="approved" targetRef="returnRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="returnRequest" targetRef="review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="review" targetRef="endRejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" name="yes" sourceRef="approved" targetRef="notify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="notify" targetRef="complete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="complete" targetRef="endHandled" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
